content.title: SRPT Stock Up 8% on Positive Long-Term Data From Elevidys Study in DMD
content.summary: SRPT jumps nearly 8% after Elevidys shows sustained motor gains and slower progression three years post-dose in the phase III EMBARK DMD study.

content.title: Is KROS' KER-065 the Next Breakthrough in DMD Space?
content.summary: KROS is advancing KER-065 for Duchenne muscular dystrophy, with orphan drug status and a phase II trial planned for early 2026.

content.title: Ionis' Dawnzera Gets EU Approval for Hereditary Angioedema
content.summary: IONS secures EU approval for Dawnzera in hereditary angioedema, after FDA clearance in the United States in August last year.

content.title: MRKR Stock Up Nearly 114% in 3 Months: Here's What You Need to Know
content.summary: Marker Therapeutics' shares jump 114% in three months as early MT-601 data showed strong responses, advanced into dose expansion, and lifted investor confidence.

content.title: Axsome Therapeutics Begins Phase III Study on AXS-14 for Fibromyalgia
content.summary: AXSM doses the first patient in the phase III FORWARD study testing AXS-14 for fibromyalgia.

content.title: Will KROS Stock's Restructuring Efforts Reap Rewards for Investors?
content.summary: Keros Therapeutics sharpens focus on KER-065 for DMD, cuts staff 45%, shelves cibotercept, and plans a phase II trial in Q1 2026 with cash runway into 2028.

content.title: CG Oncology Stock Rallies Nearly 32% in a Week: Here is Why
content.summary: CGON expects phase III PIVOT-006 top-line data in first-half 2026, nearly a year early, after enrollment finished ahead of schedule across more than 90 sites.

content.title: TVTX Stock Falls as FDA Extends Review Timeline for Filspari sNDA
content.summary: Travere Therapeutics shares fall after the FDA extends its review timeline for Filspari's sNDA in FSGS, pushing the decision date to April 2026.

content.title: TG Therapeutics Stock Rises 7% on Strong Q4 & 2025 Preliminary Results
content.summary: TGTX jumps after preliminary 2025 sales beat guidance. Its bullish 2026 revenue target and multiple Briumvi pipeline milestones also draw attention.

content.title: BEAM Outlines Key Strategic & Pipeline Goals for 2026, Stock Rises
content.summary: Beam Therapeutics jumps 22% after outlining 2026 pipeline goals, including accelerated approval plans for BEAM-302 and a potential risto-cel BLA filing.
